name: Sarah Cocker
title: Broadcast journalist, economist and executive communication coach
bio_short: Former CNBC anchor and economist with more than 25 years' experience in media, finance and executive communication. Coaches CEOs, ministers and senior executives in public speaking, media performance and strategic communication.
bio: Sarah is a broadcast journalist, economist and executive communication coach with more than 25 years' experience across media, finance and corporate communications. She anchored CNBC's flagship European breakfast programme Squawk Box and presented the European Closing Bell, interviewing business leaders, politicians and financial experts on a daily basis. Before moving into broadcast journalism, Sarah worked in investment banking at BNP Paribas, where she led the Latin American equity sales desk in London.  Sarah has held senior communication roles including head of communication and investor relations for a major UAE brand and career coach and lecturer at IMD Business School in Switzerland. She regularly moderates high-profile international conferences and events, including the Saudi Green Initiative Forum at COP28 and the Dubai International Project Management Forum.  At ISOC, Sarah delivers media training, public speaking and executive communication programmes for CEOs, government ministers and senior executives across financial services, energy, automotive and hospitality. Her combination of broadcast authority, financial fluency and coaching skill makes her particularly effective with leaders who need to communicate complex business messages with confidence and clarity. Sarah is based in Dubai and trains in English.
bio_long: Sarah is a broadcast journalist, economist and executive communication coach with more than 25 years' experience across media, finance and corporate communications. She anchored CNBC's flagship European breakfast programme Squawk Box alongside Geoff Cutmore, and presented the European Closing Bell and business news into the United States and Asia. Before moving into broadcast journalism, Sarah worked in investment banking at BNP Paribas, where she led the Latin American equity sales desk in London, placing major IPOs for European institutional investors. She holds a BSc in economics from Bayes Business School (formerly CASS), UCL.  Sarah has held senior communication roles including head of communication and investor relations for a major UAE brand and career coach and lecturer at IMD Business School in Switzerland, consistently ranked among the world's top MBA programmes. She regularly moderates high-profile international conferences, including the Saudi Green Initiative Forum at COP28 and the Dubai International Project Management Forum.  At ISOC, Sarah delivers media training, public speaking and executive communication programmes for CEOs, government ministers and senior executives across financial services, energy, automotive and hospitality. Her combination of broadcast authority, financial fluency and coaching skill makes her particularly effective with leaders who need to communicate complex business or financial messages with confidence and precision. Sarah is based in Dubai and trains in English. Jack Welch, the former CEO of GE, described her as a "trusted source."
